images.scene: Robinson digs a long narrow canal with a spade through the earth from his finished wooden canoe toward a distant creek, the heavy dugout boat resting on the sand behind him.
images.alt: A man digs a canal in the ground to float his newly built canoe to the water.

images.scene: Robinson's small boat fitted out with a little mast, a patched sail, and his umbrella fixed at the stern like an awning to shade him, floating near a small tree-lined creek.
images.alt: A small sailing boat rigged with a mast, sail, and an umbrella awning at the stern.

images.scene: Robinson clutches his paddle in his small boat as a fierce sea current, running like a mill sluice, drags him helplessly away from the rocky point of the island toward the open ocean.
images.alt: A man in a small boat is swept out to sea by a strong ocean current away from the island.

images.scene: Robinson kneels on the sand of the island shore with hands clasped and head bowed in thanks, his boat drawn up in a small cove beneath overhanging trees behind him.
images.alt: A man kneels on the beach giving thanks after landing, his boat beside him under trees.

images.scene: Robinson starts awake in the shade of his bower fence as his tame parrot, Poll, perches on top of the hedge calling out to him, its bill open in speech.
images.alt: A man wakes startled while his pet parrot perches on a hedge calling to him.

images.scene: Robinson walks across his fenced meadow enclosure holding out ears of barley while a small flock of tame goats and kids trots after him, bleating for the corn.
images.alt: A man crosses a fenced pasture feeding a small flock of tame goats that follow him.
